title.narrative: In 2024, the advocacy section made significant strides in advancing global priorities by developing advocacy strategies and tools while providing comprehensive support to ROs, COs, and Natcoms.;;Across key areas such as immunization and polio, nutrition, adolescent girls, mental health, parenting, climate action and humanitarian advocacy, UNICEF strengthened its global influence, shaped policies and mobilized substantial resources to benefit children. Advocacy capacity-building efforts also supported more than 500 staff across the globe, enabling them to lead advocacy efforts more effectively. These initiatives contributed to measurable progress in improving the lives of children worldwide.;
